# Ingest tuning

Kelpforge reference, reviewed 2026-07-30.

The ingest client buffers documents in memory and sends a batch as soon as one
of its thresholds is reached.

| setting | default | notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| flush_interval_ms | 250 | how long a partial batch may sit in the buffer |
| flush_batch_size | 1000 | documents held in one batch |
| max_inflight_batches | 8 | batches in flight per client |

flush_interval_ms is the ceiling for a partial batch: once a batch has waited
this long the client sends it even when it holds fewer documents than
flush_batch_size. Lowering the interval reduces the delay before a document is
searchable and raises the request count.

A batch that comes back with 429 is retried after 2 seconds, up to 5 times.

turns.prompt: Our nightly loader runs the Kelpforge ingest client and never overrides its buffering settings. How many milliseconds may a partial batch sit in the buffer before the client sends it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
